requirements.description: Review exact package/band matching topology and every reference-layout adaptation; a nominal 50-ohm port is not evidence matching is unnecessary.
Qualify actual routed geometry, selected fabrication stackup, return copper and solver settings; closed DRC is insufficient.
Measure tuning and RF performance with actual antenna, enclosure, power states and intended bands.
Review layer-specific matching/antenna keepouts, prescribed ground returns, short pin-to-pad distances and support circuitry.
Screen actual filled adjacent ground copper beneath routed host feed; margin needs explicit engineering basis.
